identity.original_title: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse

hooks.text: 诅咒帽可附身敌人，直接夺取其独特能力
hooks.excerpt: Possess enemies using a cursed hat. Use unique abilities from your possessed enemies to open up avenues of action and gain an advantage in battle!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 地牢材料用于重建村庄、开设施与种田备战
hooks.excerpt: Use materials collected in the dungeons to clear the rubble of ruined villages, build new facilities and cultivate crops in the fields. Prepare for your next battles at your village!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 日式手绘有限动画叠加绘本与剪纸般厚涂背景
hooks.excerpt: Traditional Japanese hand-drawn limited animation is used for character 2D animation. Thickly painted backgrounds with depth, as if you are travelling through a world of picture books and cut-out pictures.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
